sections.title: Jules — Character Overview
sections.content:
Jules, son of Richard

Jules is a young boy and NPC in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. He is Richard's son and lives in Lumière. Despite his young age, Jules dreams of training to become an expeditioner — a desire that puts him at odds with his father.

DetailInfo
NameJules

DreamWants to train as an expeditioner

sections.title: Story & Background
sections.content:
The night before his father Richard's Gommage in Monolith Year 33, Jules argues with him about his wish to train and become an expeditioner. This creates an emotional tension — Richard faces the Paintress's ritual while his son wants to follow in the dangerous footsteps of those who fight against it.

Key Moments

  • Night before the Gommage — Argues with Richard about wanting to train
  • Richard's departure — Emotional farewell scene
  • Post-story — Jules's fate depends on the outcome of the expedition

Thematic Significance

Jules represents the next generation — the children who will inherit the world that Expedition 33 is fighting to save. His desire to become an expeditioner mirrors the hope that the cycle can be broken.

sections.title: Where to Find Jules
sections.content:
Jules can be found in Lumière, primarily in the residential area near Richard's home. He appears in:

  • The prologue during pre-Gommage events
  • Specific story moments connected to Richard's arc
  • Post-game depending on your chosen path
